description: Bare Resnik best-match-average phenotype-similarity ranker (Cell R). A similarity floor on the standard cohort, and the adversarially optimal baseline on the hard cohort, whose distractors were selected with this same measure.
tie_rule: descending score, ties by the case's seeded candidate order

overlap_shift_standard.interpretation: Negative, like LIRICAL's and unlike every system that does not read the curated annotations. Cell R is an independent second instance of the exposure signature, obtained without any model or retrieval.

construction_bias_bound.interpretation: The hard cohort's distractors are the 49 genes most similar to each case under this measure, so a ranker using it is maximally disadvantaged. Its hard-cohort top-1 is therefore a lower bound on what phenotype-similarity scoring can achieve there, and the gap from its standard-cohort score is the size of the construction bias for that class of tool.
